title: Cross-team leadership roundup - serving runtime sync 2026-04-07
body:
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Liam O'Neill, Priya Raman, Diego Alvarez, Hannah Blake, Arun Iyer, + async comments from SRE and Console leads

Notes context: Weekly cross-team leadership sync focused on short-term runtime stability, rollout cadence for 7.2.0, and cross-org operational readiness for Dedicated customer onboarding. This doc records the audio notes + quick action list; informal tone, action owners called out explicitly.

Agenda (30m):
- Quick wins & incident hotfix status (5m)
- 7.2.0 candidate rollout plan + canary windows (10m)
- Dedicated onboarding checklist & network/security items (7m)
- Cross-team asks / blockers / hiring (5m)
- AOB / follow-ups

Quick wins / incidents:
- Hotfix 7.1.2 deployed to us-west-2 yesterday (diego): mitigated OOM regression for Llama2-Chat-13B-8k in partial-batched mode. Post-deploy metrics look good: 99th p95 latency back within SLO for prefix length <= 512.
- Note: we still see ~0.8% token error rate (KV cache miss race) on high-concurrency customers—SRE triage ongoing.
- Action: Diego to open a short postmortem stub and link telemetry graphs by 2026-04-09. (owner: Diego Alvarez, due: 2026-04-09)

7.2.0 rollout plan (candidate includes kernel selection improvements + batching tweaks):
- Release window: tentative 2026-04-14 to 2026-04-16 for progressive canary.
- Canary plan: 5% live traffic -> 25% -> 60% -> full, each step 2–4 hours with automated rollback on error budget or spike in 5xx.
- Canary gating signals: increase in 5xx > 0.4% over baseline, p95 latency regression > 15%, increase in token error rate > 0.5%.
- Need: Console team to provide per-route gating dashboard and automated rollback webhook.
- Action: Priya to coordinate dashboard widget and webhook spec with Console (owner: Priya Raman, due: 2026-04-10).
- Decision: We will disable the new aggressive KV prefetch in canary phase; enable in 2nd half of rollout after canary telemetry is stable. Rationale: previous partial-batched OOM edge case.

Dedicated onboarding readiness:
- Enterprise customer X (NDA in place) aims to go live mid-May. High-level asks: VPC peering + egress firewall rules, HSM integration for customer-managed keys, extended log retention for 180d.
- Security review: pending from security-and-compliance team; they requested network diagram + threat model by 2026-04-12.
- Action: Arun to produce network diagram + node sizing for Dedicated pool (owner: Arun Iyer, due: 2026-04-12).
- Action: Hannah to schedule a 60m onboarding prep call with CS + Security + Solutions Eng next Tue (owner: Hannah Blake, due: 2026-04-09).

Cross-team blockers and asks:
- Observability: SLO alert noise is masking real regressions. Ask was to standardize alert severity taxonomy across infra and runtime.
  - Proposal: adopt high/medium/low scheme and map to on-call escalation playbooks.
  - Action: Liam to draft mapping and circulate to SRE and Observability by 2026-04-11. (owner: Liam O'Neill)
- Infra: GPU fleet sizing for Q3 needs updated estimates; current model doesn't account for new quantized-llama variants.
  - Request: model footprint matrix (memory/throughput) for 4 quantization profiles.
  - Action: Maya will pull early benchmarks and share raw numbers in a gsheet by 2026-04-13 (owner: Maya Chen).
- Product: Hosted API wants a soft-deprecation plan for legacy route /v1/gen (they want to move traffic to /v2/gen with streaming). Need a compatibility shim to avoid customer breaks.
  - Action: Solutions Eng to propose shim + rollout timeline (owner: Priya Raman, due: 2026-04-15).

People / hiring / resourcing:
- Open role: Senior Inference Engineer (serving runtime); interviews in-flight. Need at least one hire onboarded by end of Q2 to meet bandwidth expectations.
- On-call rotations: upcoming gap in week of 2026-04-20 (two engineers have PTO). SRE suggested temporary backfill from Platform Eng.
  - Action: Maya to coordinate temporary rotation and send an all-hands ask in #eng-ops by 2026-04-09.

Risks & mitigation summary:
- Risk: Canary rollback frequency may increase due to underlying KV cache race (observed on 7.1.2).
  - Mitigation: conservative canary steps, disable risky prefetch, add tighter circuit-breakers on per-request memory.
- Risk: Dedicated customer onboarding timeline slipping if security review delays.
  - Mitigation: prioritize diagram + threat model; engage security for rapid review slot.

Open questions / discussion points (notes-to-self style):
- Do we need a short-term feature flag to force serial execution for high-concurrency jobs? Quick test would determine if race is concurrency-bound or memory-bound. (Priya / Diego)
- How fast can Console provision per-route retention windows? If slow, Dedicated will need separate log pipeline.
- Can we formalize a small checklist for every runtime release that includes "escape hatch" primitives (feature flag + degraded mode + metric baseline)? Could be a 1-pager in Confluence.

Decisions recorded:
- Disable aggressive KV prefetch during 7.2.0 canary (agreed).
- Use progressive canary steps with automated rollback thresholds defined above.

Action items (summary):
- Diego: postmortem stub + telemetry graphs for 7.1.2 OOM regression (due 2026-04-09).
- Priya: Console gating dashboard + rollback webhook spec; propose shim for /v1->/v2 gen (due 2026-04-10/2026-04-15).
- Arun: Dedicated network diagram + node sizing (due 2026-04-12).
- Hannah: schedule onboarding prep call with CS + Security + Solutions Eng (due 2026-04-09).
- Liam: draft alert severity mapping for SRE/Observability (due 2026-04-11).
- Maya: share GPU footprint & quantization benchmark gsheet (due 2026-04-13); coordinate on-call gap notice (due 2026-04-09).

Follow-ups / next sync:
- Next cross-team leadership sync: 2026-04-14 (30m) — will be focused on canary readiness and Dedicated onboarding status.
- Please update this doc inline with short notes if you pick up an action item; highlight completed tasks with [DONE].

Misc (raw fragments captured during meeting):
- "If p95 spikes but p99 unaffected, keep the canary open longer" — recorded as a potential adjustment to gating.
- "We should have a one-click emergency rollback documented in Console" — long-term product ask.
- Link references: CONFLUENCE-ServingRuntimeRoadmap-2026, JIRA-INF-1423 (kernel-selection-improvements), PR#918 for early batching prototype.

End of notes.

(Stamped by Maya Chen, serving-runtime lead)
